text: What should you do if you find yourself in a terrible relationship? Sounds like a question with an obvious answer, but not for everyone. This is a question I received from one of my subscribers, so let's go straight to it. Hello man, I wanted to ask you for advice after seeing your TikTok. I have a girlfriend and we are in a terrible relationship right now. I'm a slightly anxious person and about a month ago, I found out that she was hiding her status on Telegram. It turns out she had a couple status with a friend who is currently out of town. In her defense, she said she wanted to make me jealous and didn't want to delete the status right away. Then I found her second TikTok and it turns out she had a video about her friend. After that, we had a big fight and I gave her a choice, me or her friend. She doesn't want to answer this question and says that it's selfish of me. Well, after that, she said that she has known me for half a year and her friend for 3-4 years. By the way guys, if you have a dating question or an interesting relationship story, you can direct message me on TikTok, Instagram, or Telegram. So this was my answer. Look man, thanks for your question, but I'm not going to sugarcoat it. Your relationship is shit and your girlfriend does not respect you. You deserve better. End it and start building yourself up. Firstly, you say yourself that your relationship is terrible. That alone is reason number one to end it. Secondly, she has a couple status with another dude and makes a video about him. That is emotional cheating. Reason number two to end it. Thirdly, she hides stuff from you. She hid her status. She hid her second TikTok. That is lying by omission. Reason number three to end it. Fourthly, when you ask her to choose, she doesn't choose you. Which you shouldn't do, by the way. Even if she chose you, it wouldn't change anything. You should still leave. Reason number four to end it. Overall, she doesn't respect you, doesn't love you, and doesn't care about you. Find your balls, end it, and start rebuilding yourself as a man. Brick by brick, rebuild your boundaries and your self-respect. Do sports, earn money, have hobbies, and start going on dates. Then he wrote this. Thanks man, I really thought she's the one because she was helping me a lot emotionally before, but now, I guess this. Which I wrote to him, well, I told you what I think. It's up to you what to do with that information. And he wrote, yeah, thank you, I got it, just blocked her. And I sent to him my man. So, I really hope that he really ended the story and he will not get back together with her. From what I see, that sounds like a good ending for him. Thanks a lot, guys, and bye.
